name: Zoltán Magyar
milestone_by_age_26: Won European Championships gold in pommel horse at age 19 in 1973, performing the innovative Magyar Travel move for the first time, followed by World Championships gold in 1974 at age 21 and Olympic gold in 1976 at age 23.
early_history_summary: Magyar was born in Budapest and trained at Ferencvárosi TC under coach László Vigh. When his training gym underwent renovation in the late 1960s, his coach moved the pommel horse into the dressing room, leading to intense specialization on that apparatus. He won his first European title at 19 and became the world's dominant pommel horse gymnast for the next decade.
